fastmixture algorithm for population genetics clustering

Source: R/gt_fastmixture.R
gt_fastmixture.Rd

This function implements the fastmixture algorithm for population genetics clustering by calling the python module. If you use this function, make sure that you cite the relevant paper by Santander, Refoyo-Martínez, and Meisner (2024).

Usage

gt_fastmixture(
  x,
  k,
  n_runs = 1,
  threads = 1,
  seed = 42,
  iter = 1000,
  tole = 1e-09,
  batches = 32,
  supervised = NULL,
  check = 5,
  power = 11,
  chunk = 8192,
  subsample = 0.7,
  min_subsample = 50000,
  max_subsample = 5e+05,
  als_iter = 1000,
  als_tole = 1e-04,
  no_freqs = TRUE,
  random_init = FALSE,
  safety = NULL,
  cv = NULL,
  cv_tole = 1e-07
)

Arguments

x

either a tidypopgen::gen_tibble, or the name of the binary plink file (without the .bed extension)

k

the number of ancestral components (clusters), either a single value or a vector

n_runs

the number of repeats for each k value

threads

the number of threads to use (1)

seed

the random seed (defaults to 42): a vector of length n_runs, with one seed per run (the same seeds are used for each value of k), or a single seed, used for the first run and incremented for the following ones

iter

the maximum number of iterations (1000)

tole

the tolerance in log-likelihood units between iterations (1e-9)

batches

the number of maximum mini-batches (32)

supervised

the name of the file with the supervised labels (NULL)

check

the number of iterations to check for convergence (5)

power

number of power iterations in randomised SVD (11)

chunk

the number of SNPs in chunk operations (8192)

subsample

Fraction of SNPs to subsample in SVD/ALS (0.7)

min_subsample

Minimum number of SNPs to subsample in SVD/ALS (50000)

max_subsample

Maximum number of SNPs to subsample in SVD/ALS (500000)

als_iter

the maximum number of iterations in the ALS algorithm (1000)

als_tole

the tolerance for the RMSE of P between iterations (1e-4)

no_freqs

do not save P-matrix (TRUE)

random_init

random initialisation of parameters (FALSE). By default, as in the fastmixture program, the parameters are initialised from a randomised SVD of the genotypes (followed by alternating least squares), which needs all the loci to be polymorphic; random starting values can take much longer to converge

safety

deprecated and ignored: fastmixture turns on its safety updates by itself when an update is unstable

cv

the number of cross-validation folds, greater than 1 (NULL, no cross-validation)

cv_tole

the tolerance for the cross-validation error in scaled log-likelihood units (1e-7)

Value

an object of class gt_admix. See tidypopgen::gt_admixture() for details.

Details

This function returns a gt_admix object that can be plotted with autoplot, and tidied with tidy methods from the tidypopgen package. Cross-validation is not performed by default (cv = NULL); if you want to include cross-validation you can set cv to the number of folds, a value greater than 1 (ADMIXTURE performs 5-fold cv as default).

fastmixture is an optional tool, which is not needed by the rest of tidygenclust (see gt_radmix() for a native implementation of the ADMIXTURE model). Install it with tgc_tools_install(tools = "fastmixture"), or add it to an existing ctidygenclust conda environment with tgc_fastmixture_install() (only on Linux at the moment, see tgc_tools_install()).

References

C. G. Santander, A. Refoyo Martinez, J. Meisner (2024) Faster model-based estimation of ancestry proportions. bioRxiv 2024.07.08.602454; doi: https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.07.08.602454
